# telnyx_bundle_pricing_user_bundle (Data Source)

A billing bundle the account bought.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_bundle_id` (String) The user bundle.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Status of the user bundle.
- `billing_bundle` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--billing_bundle))
- `created_at` (String) Date the user bundle was created.
- `id` (String) User bundle's ID, this is used to identify the user bundle in the API.
- `resources` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `updated_at` (String) Date the user bundle was last updated.
- `user_id` (String) The customer's ID that owns this user bundle.

<a id="nestedatt--billing_bundle"></a>
### Nested Schema for `billing_bundle`

Read-Only:

- `cost_code` (String) Bundle's cost code, this is used to identify the bundle in the billing system.
- `created_at` (String) Date the bundle was created.
- `currency` (String) Bundle's currency code.
- `id` (String) Bundle's ID, this is used to identify the bundle in the API.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Available to all customers or only to specific customers.
- `mrc_price` (Number) Monthly recurring charge price.
- `name` (String) Bundle's name, this is used to identify the bundle in the UI.
- `slug` (String) Slugified version of the bundle's name.
- `specs` (List of String)


<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Date the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Resource's ID.
- `resource` (String) The resource itself (usually a phone number).
- `resource_type` (String) The type of the resource (usually 'number').
- `updated_at` (String) Date the resource was last updated.
